public_numeric_clauses: Create a stylized sandstone canyon approximately 60 m long and 36 m wide.
A dry winding passage, at least 3 m wide, must connect the foreground entrance to an opening at the far end.
Flank it with irregular terraced rock masses 8–18 m high, including at least two freestanding pillars, a natural arch with an open span of at least 6 m and scattered broken slabs.
Render a perspective main view from the passage entrance at eye height 1.7 m and a second elevated view at least 8 m above ground showing the route and arch.

material_policy.edit_baseline: Image-textured original inputs require a versioned procedural baseline and matching reference; never silently exempt inherited image textures

case_measurements: 峡谷约60×36 m；通道净宽≥3 m；岩体8–18 m高；独立柱≥2；岩拱净跨≥6 m；3植被分区；主机离地1.7 m/备用≥8 m
numeric_method: Measure selected evaluated geometry in world metres: minimum-area footprint, ray-cast local ground, component grouping, BVH clearance and swept route. Entity selectors are separate from semantic correctness; neither labels nor AABBs alone prove content or openings.
human_assistance: Resolve ambiguous geometry/entity bindings when needed
Accept calibration examples and thresholds; text semantics do not require manual scores

active_checks.source:
Create a stylized sandstone canyon approximately 60 m long and 36 m wide. A dry winding passage, at least 3 m wide, must connect the foreground entrance to an opening at the far end. Flank it with irregular terraced rock masses 8–18 m high, including at least two freestanding pillars, a natural arch with an open span of at least 6 m and scattered broken slabs. Use layered and fractured rock shapes rather than uniformly scaled cubes. Place three separated vegetation clusters with fan palms, branching cacti and low dry grasses on soil pockets, leaving the passage clear. Keep roots grounded and avoid floating rocks or impossible arch support. Use warm orange sandstone, pale dusty ground and restrained green plants, with afternoon side light that separates foreground rocks from the distant ridge. Use metres and Z up. Render a perspective main view from the passage entrance at eye height 1.7 m and a second elevated view at least 8 m above ground showing the route and arch. Render 960 by 640 pixels using Cycles, AgX, exposure 0 and gamma 1. No reference image or starting scene is supplied; the layout is yours to design.

Keep both cameras in the native scene, keep major structures independently editable and pack dependencies.

Use only supplied inputs to establish this scene. Do not retrieve the original complete model or additional views online. Do not replace three-dimensional structures with the entire reference projected onto planes.
Keep both cameras in the native scene, keep major structures independently editable and pack dependencies.

score_aggregation_note:
## 当前复评口径：v8 / Strict fidelity review

仅复评原作品，未改动原生成题面。逐题原图/文本特征；主视图必查，跨视图项必须核对所有公开原图和候选双视图。
每项列出达成、差异和严重度后评0–4级；主要缺陷最多2级，主体错误/缺失0级，不能因制作精致掩盖不忠于参考。
保持原总权重及自动/物理测量：Brief VLM60/测量30/物理10；Edit 数值20/目标30/保持20/物理10/VLM20；Reference 图像50/定位20/物理10/VLM20。
定位沿用原冻结参考框及公式，重新独立识别候选框。禁止任意配准。未展示仅扣对应项；技术失败不补零。
机器草案和裁判尚待人工校准，不声称人工认证。详见 harness/vlm_spec.json。
